source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: All expected pixels and status indicators were observed on the exact fx-880BTG PLUS in ClassPad, 19 November 2026. JSON saved directly into this project; no Downloads export.

34 full-LCD observations: exponent fractions, small and nested radicals, radicals in fractions, fractions in radicals, powers in numerators, a fraction as the power base, nested fractions and two levels of powers. No masks or referenceOnly frames in this group.

The radical hook follows an integer line from (8,0) to (6,height-2), a final (6,height-1), two left check pixels, and an eight-step descending check. Compared pixel for pixel with observed 12/15/16/19/20-pixel hooks, then verified in the full screens including height 33.

Tiny fraction numerator gap is one pixel. A terminal power in a fraction reserves two right pixels; a normal numerator ending in that power keeps a two-pixel fraction gap. Powers after tall bases align to the base top.
Results remain at their normal vertical positions when expression and answer occupy separate horizontal columns. Tested narrow tall exact fractions and a wide radical/fraction with a decimal result.

The serialized text 1/2^(3) for fraction-base-power frames is ambiguous; the observed LCD and local expression tree both show a power applied to the entire fraction (1/2)^3. Numeric expectations are PLUS observations, not independently computed replacements.
